data.action_title: I made a UPI payment / Transferred Money
data.urgent_warning: ACT IMMEDIATELY (GOLDEN HOUR): Dial 1930 as soon as possible. Rapid reporting gives authorities and banks the best window to attempt placing a hold or lien on suspect beneficiary accounts, though fund recovery cannot be guaranteed once money is withdrawn or moved across accounts.
immediate_steps: Dial 1930 immediately to report the transaction ID, UPI reference number (UTR), and recipient UPI handle to the National Cyber Financial Fraud helpline (early reporting is critical, though full recovery depends on whether funds remain unwithdrawn).
Call your bank's fraud reporting helpline immediately (printed on the back of your debit card) and request a transaction dispute and lien on the beneficiary account.
Take screenshots of the payment confirmation screen, recipient UPI ID/account number, and the conversation thread as forensic evidence.
Register an official complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (https://cybercrime.gov.in) under 'Financial Fraud'.
Visit your local cyber police station to file an FIR with your complaint acknowledgement number if loss exceeds local thresholds.

preventative_measures: Remember: Entering your UPI PIN ALWAYS debits money from your account. You NEVER need to enter a UPI PIN to receive money.
Block the fraudster's number on WhatsApp and Truecaller.
Never send a test amount of ₹1 or ₹5 to unlock refunds.
